svg.title: Untimely dusk — closing-movement emblems
svg.desc: Four chapter-open emblems (dancing quill, skirmish rank, Dionysian mask, diamond over coal), raid pips, movement marker, end seal, and contents pips; ivory line-engraving with bronze structure and ember cracks.

symbol.title: Dancing quill striking the flatland horizon
Rank of three shields, the centre one cracked
Wreathed mask of Dionysos on the noon disc
Faceted diamond over coal, split by the verdict crack
Movement-head marker: cracked disc with ember core
Contents mark: quill above the line
Contents mark: three bars, centre cracked
Contents mark: mask circle with brow tick
